# datasintef_minio (Resource)

Manages a MinIO service instance in a datahub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datasintef_minio" "example" {
  datahub                     = "my-hub"
  service_alias               = "my-bucket"
  display_name                = "Test Bucket"
  description                 = "Test ordering minio bucket"
  storage_tier                = "cool"
  research_project_id         = "123456789-0"
  service_data_classification = "SINTEF Business Confidential"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datahub` (String) Alias of the datahub (e.g. 'my-hub'). Also accepts the datahub UUID.
- `description` (String) Description of the MinIO service instance.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the MinIO service instance.
- `research_project_id` (String) Research project ID.
- `service_alias` (String) Alias of the MinIO service instance.
- `service_data_classification` (String) Classification of the data/information the service instance holds. Valid values: Open, SINTEF Business Confidential, SINTEF Confidential. dsn-api only allows sharing a service with the public when it is classified as `Open`.
- `storage_tier` (String) Storage tier ('hot' or 'cool').

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) Service endpoint addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the MinIO service instance (datahub:service_alias).
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp when the service was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Time to wait for the service to become Ready (condition `Ready=True, reason=Available`) after a Create. Defaults to 20m. Must be less than the dsn-api 30 minute creation ceiling.
- `update` (String) Time to wait for the service to become Ready after an Update. Defaults to 15m.


<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The endpoint URL.
- `description` (String) Description of the address.
- `type` (String) The address type (e.g. 'ui', 'api').
